effectGroup.name: Initiative Proficiency
effectGroup.description: When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll

effectGroup.name: Initiative Swap
effectGroup.description: Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitaed condition.

effectGroup.name: Two Cantrips
effectGroup.description: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. Intelligence, Wisdomm, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells (choose when you select this feat)

effectGroup.name: Level 1 Spell
effectGroup.description: Choose one level 1 spell from the Cleric spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

effectGroup.name: Spell Change
effectGroup.description: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the Cleric spell list.

effectGroup.name: Savage Attacker
effectGroup.description: You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

effectGroup.name: Skilled
effectGroup.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

choices.prompt: Choose three proficiencies in any combination of skills or tools of your choice.

effectGroup.name: Ability Score Increase
effectGroup.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1 each.

effectGroup.name: Ability Score Increase
effectGroup.description: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

effectGroup.name: Punch and Grab
effectGroup.description: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

effectGroup.name: Attack Advantage
effectGroup.description: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you
